transcript_path.description: Path to the conversation JSON. Written asynchronously, so it can lag the current turn; on Stop and SubagentStop read last_assistant_message instead.

cwd.description: Working directory when the hook is invoked. Follows Claude into a worktree or after a cd, while CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR stays at the project root where the session started.

prompt_id.description: UUID of the user prompt being processed; matches the prompt.id attribute on OpenTelemetry events. Absent until the first user input.

scratchpad_dir.description: Path to the session's scratchpad directory. Absent when the session has none or the temp directory is unavailable. Claude Code 2.1.257 or later.

permission_mode.description: Current permission mode. The mode labelled Manual arrives as default. Not every event carries this field.

level.description: The effort level that ran, including a skill's, subagent's or ultrathink level. CLAUDE_EFFORT holds the same value.

effort.description: Present on events with a tool-use context, on models that support effort.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the subagent or in-process teammate the hook fires in.

agent_type.description: Agent name, such as Explore or a plugin-scoped my-plugin:reviewer. Present inside a subagent, or when the session runs with --agent; a subagent's type wins over the session's.

from_model.description: Model ID the switch changes from.

to_model.description: Model ID the switch changes to. The matcher compares against this model's canonical name.

requested_model.description: The model the request named: an alias such as opus, a full model ID, or null for the default model or a change Claude Code made on its own.

source.description: Where the request came from: command for /model <name>, /config or fast mode; picker for a model picker; sdk for an Agent SDK host or Remote Control.

context_tokens.description: Tokens the next request re-sends as its prompt. 0 before the first response.

prompt_cache_warm.description: Whether the current model's prompt cache is likely still warm, so the switch forfeits it.

cache_ttl.description: Prompt cache lifetime of the main conversation at the time of the switch.

estimated_cache_write_usd.description: Estimated cost in US dollars of writing context_tokens to the prompt cache on to_model. An estimate only.

pricing.description: How the estimate was priced: your organization's rates, list price, or an assumed default rate.

title: PreModelSwitch hook input
description: A model switch the user or a client requested is about to apply. Claude Code 2.1.251 or later. The matcher compares against the canonical name of to_model; when none can be determined every hook runs, so check to_model too. Default timeout 30 seconds, and a timeout blocks the switch.
